title: [Bug]: nvidia/Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4 (dense, MIXED_PRECISION W4A16_NVFP4) fails to load — "RuntimeError: start (0) + length (17408) exceeds dimension size (8704)"
author: yinjiuxun

comments.author: pranavthakur0-0
comments.body: can I work on this issue ?

comments.author: ArsalanShakil
comments.body:
I looked into this on current `main` using the actual published `nvidia/Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4` config, and I can't reproduce the fall-through — the mixed-precision dispatch chain appears to route the dense `W4A16_NVFP4` layers correctly now. Sharing what I found in case it helps narrow it down.

**Config selection → per-layer routing (verified against the real `config.json` `quantization_config`):**

- `ModelOptMixedPrecisionConfig.override_quantization_method(...)` → `"modelopt_mixed"` (so a `MIXED_PRECISION` checkpoint is picked up regardless of `--quantization modelopt`/`modelopt_fp4`, via the override scan in `config/model.py`).
- `_resolve_quant_algo("language_model.model.layers.0.mlp.down_proj")` → `W4A16_NVFP4` (and `...linear_attn.out_proj` → `FP8`). The `language_model.model.` ↔ `model.language_model.` prefix swap is handled by `_quantized_layer_prefix_candidates`.
- `get_quant_method(...)` for that `W4A16_NVFP4` `LinearBase` returns `ModelOptNvFp4W4A16LinearMethod` (`modelopt.py:2508`), i.e. it does **not** fall through to `UnquantizedLinearMethod`.

(All of the above is the pure config→dispatch decision, checked on CPU; I don't have GB10/sm_121 hardware to run the full weight load + Marlin kernel end-to-end.)

Two things I noticed that might explain the discrepancy:

1. The published `config.json` reports `architectures: ["Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration"]` (multimodal, `language_model_only: false`), whereas the issue lists `Qwen3_5ForCausalLM`. The quantized-layer keys are prefixed `model.language_model.…`, which lines up with the multimodal wrapper's `language_model.model.…` module prefixes. Under the current config this resolves.

2. All of the mixed-precision + `W4A16_NVFP4` dispatch machinery (#35047, #42566) predates the build in the report (`0.23.1rc1.dev515`, ~2026-06-27), so it's possible the model's HF config was updated after filing.

Could you retest on the latest nightly and confirm whether it still fails? If it does, it'd help to attach the exact `config.json` and `hf_quant_config.json` you're loading (or `git rev-parse HEAD` of the image) and the arch actually instantiated, so the failing prefix can be pinned down.

One latent edge I did spot while tracing: `_resolve_quant_algo` bridges `language_model.model.` ↔ `model.language_model.`, but not a bare `model.layers.N.…` prefix → `model.language_model.layers.N.…` keys. That only matters for a text-only load path, which the current multimodal config doesn't take — mentioning it in case your setup instantiates the LM standalone.

comments.author: yinjiuxun
comments.body:
Closing this — root cause was a stale image, not a vLLM bug. Apologies for the noise, and thanks a lot for the detailed trace through the dispatch chain.

**What happened:** the version I reported (`0.23.1rc1.dev515+g68ee8300a`) was from a *different* service. The container that actually failed was running an **older image** (`vllm/vllm-openai:cu130-nightly`), which reports:

```
Initializing a V1 LLM engine (v0.19.2rc1.dev134+gfe9c3d6c5)
```

On that old build the dense `W4A16_NVFP4` `down_proj` dispatch was incomplete, hence `input_scale not found` → `narrow() ... exceeds dimension size (8704)`.

**Confirmed fix:** switching that service to `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly` (0.23.x) loads `nvidia/Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4` successfully. As you noted, the arch resolves to `Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration` with `quantization=modelopt_mixed`, so the text-only prefix edge you spotted was not involved here — it was purely the older image lacking the mixed-precision W4A16 dispatch from #42566.

Thanks again — closing as resolved.
